description: Header language switcher submission — Shopify native localization-form (Dawn theme), POST /localization sets locale_code=vi, 302 redirect, subsequent URLs prefixed /vi/. Matches Shopify shop-locales locale codes observed by portal-explorer (en, vi).

entries.postData_summary: multipart form: form_type=localization, _method=put, return_to=/, locale_code=vi (no credential fields)
